notes: Editor walk-round: new to Cutnote? A short tour shows you round the editor, then the Hub. Replay it from the Cutnote menu.
Content OS on every project: each Hub card has a button that opens the video in Content OS (or Content OS itself).
Smoother Hub cards: they lift slowly with a lime neon edge and a glowing Open button in the middle.
Nicer ⋯ menu: it slides open smoothly, and can link a project to Content OS.
Tidier What's new: this screen now fits on one page.
